result.title: MeshBind: Point-to-Mesh Binding for Non-Rigid Scene Flow Automatic Annotation
result.summary: Scene flow estimation is essential for many autonomous driving (AD) and robotic applications, but obtaining ground-truth scene flow for non-rigid objects such as pedestrians is highly difficult. We present MeshBind, an automatic annotation method that uses mesh models to generate per-point scene flow for non-rigid objects. The novelty of this work is threefold: 1) developing a multi-view module that reconstructs an articulated mesh model from six surround cameras and registers it to the LiDAR frame; 2) developing a local-frame binding technique that attaches each point to the mesh via a per-triangle tangent-normal frame, invariant under rigid motion yet adaptive to articulated deformation; 3) developing a three-layer flow registration pipeline that combines ego-vehicle motion compensation, box binding, and mesh binding to produce full-scene per-point flow. We implement MeshBind in SF-Studio, an interactive annotation tool that visualises flow and allows human mesh corrections with automatic recomputation. We also release SFB (SUScape-Flow Benchmark), a large-scale benchmark built on the public SUScape dataset, covering 41k frames with per-point non-rigid pedestrian annotations and a Rigid/Semi-Rigid/Non-Rigid evaluation protocol. Experiments show that fine-tuning on SFB reduces three-way endpoint error (EPE) by 2-3x, and brings non-rigid EPE to the same level as rigid EPE.

AI.brief_summary: MeshBind 是一种面向自动驾驶的自动标注方法，用多视角重建的网格模型为行人等非刚性物体生成逐点场景流，并配套交互式标注工具与大规模基准 SFB。
AI.relevance_reason: 属 3D 点云场景流标注与几何配准工作，不涉及 VLM 推理状态、视觉证据筛选或 THINK/LOOK/STOP 决策，也未提供可核查的 latent reasoning 方法线索，暂无实质联系。
